AddonHealth.description: AddonHealth is an add-on's health in `cluster describe`, derived from its EKS status.

Decision.description: Decision represents the overall decision for proceeding with update

name.description: name identifies the item. For KindRegion it is the region name.

operation.description: operation is the IAM action that failed, such as "eks:DescribeNodegroup".

retryable.description: retryable reports whether running the same command again, with no other change, may succeed. It is always encoded.

error.description: error is one line of human text. Do not parse it; use Reason.

awsErrorCode.description: awsErrorCode is the raw AWS API error code, such as AccessDeniedException, when the failure came from an API response.

Failure.description: Failure is one item refresh could not read, or one action it attempted that did not complete. The JSON and YAML keys are a public contract (docs/concepts/output.md): later versions only add fields.

FailureKind.description: FailureKind is the type of item a Failure is about.

FailureList.description: A list of failures. It is [] when there are none, never null.

FailureReason.description: FailureReason is why a Failure happened, from a closed set. Scripts branch on it. Later versions may add reasons; consumers must accept unknown values.

HealthIssue.description: HealthIssue is one AWS-reported health issue on a cluster/nodegroup/addon — the common shape behind EKS's ClusterIssue / NodegroupIssue / AddonIssue.

skipped.description: skipped marks a check that could not be evaluated (e.g. no Kubernetes client) rather than measured. Skipped checks are excluded from the OverallScore so a missing prerequisite doesn't silently drag the score.

HealthResult.description: HealthResult represents the result of a single health check

HealthStatus.description: HealthStatus represents the status of a health check

failures.description: failures are the EKS and Kubernetes reads the node and PDB checks could not make. The check that needed the data warns or fails instead of passing, so the Decision already accounts for them. [] when empty.

HealthSummary.description: HealthSummary represents the overall health check results

NetworkingInfo.description: NetworkingInfo contains VPC and networking details

readyNodes.description: readyNodes is valid only when ReadyKnown is true (a measured Kubernetes Ready=True count). Otherwise readiness was not measured.

daysRemaining.description: daysRemaining counts down to the end of the current tier (standard or extended). Negative once the window has closed.

extraCostUsdPerHour.description: extraCostUsdPerHour is the per-cluster premium of the current tier over standard support (0 unless extended).

autoUpgradeAtStandardEnd.description: autoUpgradeAtStandardEnd is true when the cluster's upgrade policy is STANDARD: EKS auto-upgrades it at the end of standard support instead of moving it to (paid) extended support.

fallback.description: fallback is true when the posture came from the compiled-in calendar because DescribeClusterVersions was unavailable.

SupportPosture.description: SupportPosture is the resolved support window for a cluster's version.

SupportTier.description: SupportTier is the EKS support posture for a cluster's Kubernetes version.

apiVersion.description: The version of the document contract.

support.description: support is the EKS version support posture (tier + days remaining), resolved via the shared status resolver. Populated by the command layer.

supportType.description: supportType is the cluster's upgrade policy (STANDARD or EXTENDED). With STANDARD, EKS auto-upgrades the cluster at the end of standard support.

health.description: health is the pre-flight health verdict, with --show-health.

healthIssues.description: healthIssues are AWS-reported control-plane health issues (DescribeCluster's Health.Issues) — degraded resources, IAM/permission failures, etc. Distinct from the computed Health summary above. Always populated when present, even without ShowHealth.

networking.description: networking is the cluster's VPC, subnets, security groups, and endpoint access.

security.description: security is the cluster's encryption, IAM role, logging, and deletion protection.

addons.description: addons are the installed add-ons. The key is left out when the add-ons were not read (--no-addons, or a failed listing in Failures).

nodegroups.description: nodegroups are the managed nodegroups, with --detailed. The key is left out when the nodegroups were not read (no --detailed, or a failed listing in Failures).

tags.description: tags are the cluster's AWS tags.

failures.description: Every failure of the run: the items refresh could not read and the actions that did not complete. This top-level list is complete; a nested failure or failures field repeats a subset of it. The list is sorted by kind, region, cluster, name, and operation. [] when there are no failures.

title: ClusterDescription
description: The document that `refresh cluster describe -o json` prints. -o yaml prints the same structure.
